The color of the arrows will tell you if, at the current speed, you will be able to pass the next traffic light or if you should otherwise slow down. This enables the adaptation of driving according to whether or not it is possible to go green according to the time remaining for the phase change. In this way, hard acceleration and braking can be avoided, helping to reduce emissions and consumption. The application will also alert when it detects a risk of exceeding a red traffic light.

- ALERTS which inform the driver about traffic jams, road works or accidents ahead that allow more secure anticipation of unforeseen situations on the routes.

- NOTICE OF SENSITIVE ZONES: School zones or limited to 30 km / h

- TRAFFIC INFORMATION: such as, for example, estimated travel times to key points in the city or information about closed streets or areas that will help to better plan the route to follow.

- PARKING: Information on the location of the underground car parks in the city and an indication of the availability of free spaces (if the Car Park publishes such information)
